tasks.short: Chase financial documents. The lender determines eligibility.

steps.what: List the financial documents still missing from the clients.

loop.input: File against the document names the lender asked for
loop.check: A row appears only if that document is absent
loop.why_not_simpler: Clients label the same document in different words

steps.what: Chase those documents once the list is accepted.
Assess credit status and eligibility for financing.
Investigate the reply and determine what the clients should hear.
File the status the lender gave, not a homemade score.

tasks.design: The agent lists missing documents and chases them after checking the list. The lender assesses credit and eligibility. The agent investigates the reply and tells the client what it means. The agent does not make a score.
tasks.previous_blocker: Documents were chased from a notebook, and eligibility was sometimes guessed on the phone.
tasks.enabler_now: A list of expected documents can find gaps. A credit decision cannot.
tasks.still_hard: Explaining a refusal without inventing a reason the lender did not give.
tasks.human_edge: The agent will not tell a client they are eligible.

ambition.what: No new service. Eligibility stays with the lender. The chase gets a list.

tasks.altitude: The agent can refuse to guess eligibility. Document chasing shrinks only when the expected list is real.

reach.role: securities and financial services sales agent
reach.task: Read a lender refusal without adding a reason
reach.learn: Which sentences about eligibility the agent must not say

evidence.claim: A checklist can find missing documents. Determining credit eligibility is the lender's judgement.
Financial and credit details need a purpose and a short field list. A homemade score is not that purpose.
Sales agents are in scope of anti-money-laundering checks on client identity.

assumptions: Focal role is the sales agent. Boundary: from a thin file to a stored lender status. The lender's assessment is supplier time and is not saved.
The design disagrees with the task wording that the agent determines eligibility. National rules on who may judge credit are not named in the digest. The agent collects and explains.
Fields: document name, received yes or no, and the status words the lender used. Fallback: do not chase a document the agent has not seen on the list.
Upkeep of 4 hours covers the expected-document list. No credit model is built.
unknowns: Which documents the usual lender requires.
research_questions: What share of chases ask for a document the client already sent?

incremental.description: Update the expected documents when lenders change what they ask

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Low: files are messy and the reply still takes a full reading. High: the chase message shrinks, the lender's time is not saved, and the agent still does not score the client.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Assemble a financing pack, submit it, and chase the exceptions.

steps.what: Assemble the construction or purchase financing pack.

loop.check: Every item is present or marked missing
loop.why_not_simpler: A missing page cannot be invented

steps.what: Check the pack before it leaves for the mortgage company.
Submit the approved pack to the mortgage company.
Decide whether to secure the financing for this file.
Chase exceptions the mortgage company sends back.

tasks.design: The pack is assembled from files the lender named, checked by the agent, and submitted to the {PARTNER_PORTAL}. Securing the financing is the lender's decision. The agent chases exceptions by phone and mail.
tasks.previous_blocker: Packs were assembled in a mail thread, and exceptions were discovered late.
tasks.enabler_now: A named list of pages can build an index. A credit decision cannot.
tasks.still_hard: Clearing an exception that is about the client, not about a missing page.
tasks.human_edge: The agent does not tell the client the financing is secured before the lender says so.

ambition.what: Each pack is marked complete or blocked before it is submitted, not after the lender rejects it.

tasks.altitude: Exception calls stay. The agent can refuse to submit a pack, and cannot secure the loan themselves.

reach.role: securities and financial services sales agent
reach.task: Read a lender exception that is not a missing page
reach.learn: Which exceptions the agent may chase and which need the lender's adviser

evidence.claim: A pack index can be checked against a list. The decision to lend stays with the lender.
Identity checks sit with anti-money-laundering duties on the agent. They are not the lending decision.

assumptions: Focal role is the sales agent. Boundary: from client and property files to a submitted pack and chased exceptions. The lender's decision is supplier time.
The design disagrees with reading 'secure' as the agent's act. The agent prepares and chases. The firm or the mortgage company decides.
Fields: the lender's document names, present or missing. Fallback: mark missing, do not submit.
Use the lender's portal before a private upload site. Upkeep of 4 hours covers the document list. No rate model.
unknowns: Whether the firm's own desk lends, or only outside mortgage companies.
Which portal the usual lender offers.
research_questions: What share of packs are rejected for a page the index had marked present?

incremental.description: Keep the pack list aligned with each lender's current ask

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Low: exceptions are about the client and stay as calls. High: assembly and submission shrink, the lender's decision is not saved, and the chase stays.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Filter candidate sites, visit them, and judge the market on foot.

steps.what: Locate candidate areas for building sites in the register.
Cut the list to sites worth a visit.
Visit the undeveloped areas and appraise them on foot.
Judge market conditions based on the visit, not a model.
Write the site note from the visit, model value aside.

loop.check: A price figure appears only if the agent typed it
loop.why_not_simpler: A nearby sale is not a site value

tasks.design: The register filter finds candidate areas. The agent cuts the list, visits the undeveloped ground, and judges market conditions from that visit. A model value of nearby homes, if shown, is a column, not the site value. The note says which figure the agent typed.
tasks.previous_blocker: Sites were found by driving around, and a model price of nearby homes was sometimes used as the land price.
tasks.enabler_now: Planning status can filter a map. Valuing bare land cannot.
tasks.still_hard: Seeing access, flooding or a neighbour problem that the register does not show.
tasks.human_edge: The agent will not name a site value they have not stood on.

ambition.what: Each candidate is marked visit, skip or revisit before anyone names a figure.

tasks.altitude: Visits stay. The agent can refuse a note that copies a model figure into the value.

reach.task: Confirm a site fact the register cannot show
reach.learn: Which site constraints a visit still has to check

evidence.claim: A tested model value is not a loan value and is not used as the price of a building site.
A large buyer quit home buying after a write-down it blamed on price forecasts.

assumptions: Focal role is the sales agent. Boundary: from a register filter to a site note the agent will say aloud. Nearby home values are context.
Fields: area, planning status, size. The agent produces the visit judgement. Fallback: no model column.
Use the register before a new map. A paid value feed is the run cost. Upkeep of 3 hours covers filter rules.
The class is human. The visit is the appraisal.
unknowns: Which planning fields the register exposes to an agent.
Whether clients expect a number on the first visit.
research_questions: What share of filtered sites are rejected on the visit?

incremental.description: Retire filter rules that send the agent to impossible sites

approvals.approved_version: site judgement the agent made after the visit

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Low: the visit overturns the list and the note is rewritten. High: finding candidates shrinks, and the visit and the judgement stay. A forecast is not the site value.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Draft an outline from approved material, then conduct the session.

steps.what: Draft a seminar outline from approved sales material only.

loop.check: Every section cites an approved paragraph
loop.stop: One draft; an unsourced section is cut
loop.why_not_simpler: Approved material does not know this room

steps.what: Cut techniques the agency has not approved for training.
Conduct seminars so sales agents improve their techniques.
Note which techniques agents still struggle to use.

tasks.design: An outline is drafted only from material the agency has approved. The agent cuts anything else, then conducts the seminar in the room. Notes afterwards name techniques people still struggle with. The session is not recorded.
tasks.previous_blocker: Outlines were rewritten the night before, and the same anecdote was taught differently by each agent.
tasks.enabler_now: Approved material can be arranged into an outline. Teaching a room cannot.
tasks.still_hard: Noticing, in the room, which technique people nod at and cannot do.
tasks.human_edge: The agent changes the next exercise because of what just failed.

ambition.what: No new service. The same approved techniques are taught, and the agent still runs the room.

tasks.altitude: Delivery stays. The agent can throw out an outline section that is not approved material.

reach.task: Say which techniques new agents must be able to demonstrate
reach.learn: Which techniques the broker treats as required rather than optional

evidence.claim: An outline can be arranged from approved text. Conducting the session stays with the trainer.
People using a drafted outline need to know it is a draft and to check it against the approved material.
Recording a session in a way that can monitor staff needs works-council consent. This design does not record it.

assumptions: Focal role is the agent who conducts the session. Boundary: from approved material to a delivered seminar and notes on what failed. Listeners' time is not this task.
The outline may only quote approved material. The agent produces the cuts and the delivery. Fallback: teach from the approved pages directly.
Use the material already in {LMS} or {DOCS}. Upkeep of 3 hours covers outlines after the material changes.
The class is human. The room is the work.
unknowns: Whether the office has approved teaching material.
research_questions: Which techniques are still weak a month after the session?

incremental.description: Revise outlines when the approved material changes

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Low: the session is the task and the outline is rewritten in the room. High: preparing the outline shrinks, and conducting it stays.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: Eligibility, the lender's yes, the site visit and the training room stay with people. Lists, packs and outlines are ready before those moments.
reach: Solar sales representatives: confirm on a visit the site facts a register cannot show
skills_to_grow: Chasing documents without scoring a client
Reading a lender exception that is not a missing page
Teaching only techniques the agency has approved
role.ambitious_version: A financing file is complete or openly blocked before it is submitted, and a site is visited before anyone names a value.
